chunks: From a sermon of him (peace be upon him) when the news of the Breakers of the Oath reached him regarding his allegiance [and in it he condemns their action and holds them responsible for the blood of Uthman and threatens them with war]

key_terms.النَّاكِثِينَ: The Breakers (of the oath of allegiance)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the Nakithun and Uthman's blood in his sermon?
ai.summary: In this sermon, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) clarifies the distinction between the 'Nakithun' (those who broke the oath, primarily Aisha, Talha, and Zubayr) and the 'Qasitun' (the usurpers, Muawiyah), while holding them collectively responsible for Caliph Uthman’s blood due to their failure to secure justice. This rhetorical strategy underscores the Shia scholarly view that their rebellion was not merely political but a breach of the covenant of allegiance, justifying the subsequent Battle of the Camel.
